title: Rebrand and customize the existing study/to-do app into “Maleeha Focus” (Pharm-D) with For Maleeha section

requirements.text: Update all app naming and copy from the current “Taruba Focus / CEC” branding to “Maleeha Focus” for a Pharm-D student, ensuring all user-facing text is English only.

quotes: Create an iOS (iPhone) app in ENGLISH only – a To-Do, Study Manager and Motivation app designed for a Pharm-D student with a special “For Maleeha” section.

acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab title shows “Maleeha Focus”.
PWA manifest name/short_name and description reference “Maleeha Focus” and Pharm-D (not Taruba/CEC).
No user-facing text mentions Taruba, Muzzamil, or CEC after the change.
All user-facing text remains English only.

requirements.text: Replace the existing task categories and subjects with the requested Pharm-D categories and subjects, and ensure category selection + filtering continues to work across the app.

quotes:
CATEGORIES

1. Pharm-D Study
   
   - Pharmaceutics
   - Medicinal Biochemistry
   - Human Anatomy and Physiology
   - Organic Chemistry
   - Inorganic Chemistry
   - Remedial Maths

2. Personal

3. Health & Routine

4. For Maleeha 🌸

acceptanceCriteria: Category list contains exactly: “Pharm-D Study”, “Personal”, “Health & Routine”, “For Maleeha”.
Pharm-D Study subject list contains exactly: “Pharmaceutics”, “Medicinal Biochemistry”, “Human Anatomy and Physiology”, “Organic Chemistry”, “Inorganic Chemistry”, “Remedial Maths”.
When creating/editing a task, selecting “Pharm-D Study” exposes a subject picker; other categories do not.
Home category cards and the task filter bar reflect the new categories and correctly filter task lists.
Existing stored tasks from previous categories are handled safely (e.g., mapped or shown under a fallback) without crashing.

requirements.text: Implement/rename the special category section to “For Maleeha 🌸” with the requested preset tasks, a flower completion indicator, and a soft pastel accent applied only within this category’s UI elements.

quotes:
FOR MALEEHA SPECIAL SECTION

- Tasks:
  - “Check on Maleeha’s day”
  - “Encourage her study”
  - “Family time reminder”
- Flower icon when task completed
- Soft pastel accent only for this section

acceptanceCriteria: When “For Maleeha” is the selected category on Home, a quick-add card appears offering exactly the 3 preset tasks provided.
Quick-adding a preset creates a task in category “For Maleeha”.
Completed tasks in category “For Maleeha” display a flower icon indicator (and non-“For Maleeha” tasks do not use the flower indicator).
Only UI elements within the “For Maleeha” quick-add card and/or “For Maleeha” task styling use the special soft pastel accent; other categories keep the normal palette.

requirements.text: Update the daily quote generator to use exactly the 20 provided “from Chotu” quotes (verbatim), with random selection and a manual refresh action, while keeping the existing “daily persistence” behavior.

quotes:
DAILY QUOTE GENERATOR (from Chotu)
Use these quotes randomly:

1. I believe in your hard work more than any fear you have.
...
20. I trust your journey and your strength.

acceptanceCriteria: The quote source list contains exactly 20 quotes matching the user-provided text (including punctuation such as em dashes and apostrophes).
The app shows one quote at a time and allows manual refresh from the quote card.
A quote persists for the day and changes automatically when the calendar day changes (existing behavior preserved).
No quote attribution text displays a different name than “Chotu” (if attribution is displayed at all).

requirements.text: Apply the specified iOS-style theme palette across the app (light + dark mode), including updating global theme colors to match: Primary #FFD6E0, Secondary #D4C1FF, Background #FFF6F9, Success #C8FFD4, Text #2F2F2F.

quotes:
APP THEME (iOS STYLE)

Colors

- Primary: Soft Pastel Peach #FFD6E0
- Secondary: Lavender #D4C1FF
- Background: Cream White #FFF6F9
- Success: Mint Green #C8FFD4
- Text: Charcoal #2F2F2F

acceptanceCriteria: Light theme surfaces/backgrounds match the requested palette (with appropriate contrast).
Dark mode remains available and readable; no hard-coded light-only colors break dark mode.
Category color styling is updated so the new categories have consistent, iOS-like soft tint styling.
Theme color meta/manifest values are consistent with the updated palette.

requirements.text: Ensure typography matches the request: use iOS-system style for general UI (San Francisco-like) and render quotes in a soft handwritten style.

quotes:
Fonts

- Use iOS system fonts (San Francisco)
- Quotes in soft handwritten style

acceptanceCriteria: General UI text uses system font stacks appropriate for iOS (San Francisco-style).
Quote text uses a handwritten/cursive font style distinct from the main UI text.
Typography changes do not introduce layout overflow/clipping in the quote card.

requirements.text: Confirm the Home screen layout matches the requested structure for “Maleeha Focus”: top date + quote card, middle category cards, bottom floating add button, and ensure the displayed date is today’s date.

quotes:
UI LAYOUT

- Top: Date + Quote card
- Middle: Category cards (iOS rounded)
- Bottom: Floating Add button
Show today date on home screen

acceptanceCriteria: Home shows today’s date at the top.
Quote card appears near the top beneath the date.
Category cards appear in the middle with iOS-like rounded styling.
A floating add button is fixed near the bottom and opens the task creation dialog.

requirements.text: Keep the existing task CRUD behavior (add title/description/time, edit, delete, mark completed) and ensure tasks persist locally/offline after closing and reopening.

quotes:
CORE FEATURES

- Add task with title, description and time
- Edit, delete, mark completed
- Tasks saved permanently using iOS local storage

iOS REQUIREMENTS

- Offline working
- Data safe after closing

acceptanceCriteria: Users can create tasks with title, optional description, and optional time.
Users can edit and delete tasks.
Users can mark tasks completed/uncompleted.
Tasks persist via local storage and are still present after a full page reload.
Core flows continue to work with no network connectivity.

requirements.text: Maintain the focus system as a 45-minute focus timer with a short break after completion, with an iOS-style progress ring animation, and ensure the “Do Not Disturb during focus” request is represented as in-app distraction reduction (without claiming OS-level DND control).

quotes:
FOCUS SYSTEM

- 45 Minute Focus Timer
- Short break after timer
- Progress ring animation (iOS style)
- Do Not Disturb during focus

acceptanceCriteria: Focus phase duration is 45 minutes and break starts automatically after the focus timer completes.
The progress ring animates smoothly during the timer.
The UI provides an in-app distraction reduction mode (e.g., hide non-essential UI) and does not claim to toggle the phone’s OS-level Do Not Disturb.

requirements.text: Update the Attendance Tracker area to align with the Pharm-D context (copy/labels), while preserving: subject list management, present/absent marking, attendance percentage, and the monthly calendar view.

quotes:
ATTENDANCE TRACKER

- Add subjects list
- Present / Absent marking
- Attendance percentage
- Monthly calendar view (Apple style)

acceptanceCriteria: Users can add/edit/delete subjects in Attendance.
Users can mark days as Present/Absent per subject.
Attendance percentage and counts display correctly.
Monthly calendar view remains available and usable.
Any CEC-specific wording is removed from the Attendance UI.

requirements.text: Add an “App Store description” section in Settings (or an About section) that displays the provided description text verbatim in English.

quotes:
APP STORE DESCRIPTION

“Maleeha Focus is a simple and caring study companion created by her brother Chotu.
The app helps Pharm-D students manage daily tasks, track attendance, and study with a 45-minute focus system. It includes motivational quotes and a special section dedicated to encouraging Maleeha in her journey. Designed with a calm iOS style to reduce stress and build consistency.”

acceptanceCriteria: Settings includes a readable section showing the provided App Store description text verbatim.
The description is displayed in English only and references Maleeha and Chotu as provided.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components); compose them instead.
Do not modify immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); only add migration if existing stable state must change.
nonGoals: Native iOS widget implementation (home screen widgets) is out of scope for this web/PWA build.
Face ID / passcode lock is out of scope for this web/PWA build.
True OS-level Do Not Disturb control is out of scope; only in-app distraction reduction is supported.

edits: Update the app icon to match the provided logo idea: open book + small pharmacy leaf, soft peach & lavender gradient, minimal flower symbol, rounded friendly iOS icon style (app-icon.dim_512x512.png > app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
